armyRules.name: Acts of Faith
armyRules.effect: Each unit with this ability can perform one Act of Faith per phase using Miracle dice. Gain 1 Miracle dice at the start of each turn and each time an Adepta Sororitas unit is destroyed (roll 1D6 for its value, fixed unless stated otherwise). Before any Advance roll, Battle-shock test, Charge roll, Damage roll, Hit roll, saving throw, or Wound roll, you can substitute one Miracle dice's value for that roll instead of rolling (only a single dice within a multi-dice roll can be substituted).

battleFormations.name: Hallowed Martyrs
battleFormations.effect: The Blood of Martyrs: Adepta Sororitas attacks gain +1 to Hit if the unit is below Starting Strength, and +1 to Wound as well if Below Half-strength.

battleFormations.name: Penitent Host
battleFormations.effect: Desperate for Redemption: At the start of the battle round, select one Vow of Atonement (once each per battle): The Path of the Penitent (+3" Move for Penitent models), Absolution in Battle (+1 Attacks/Strength on melee for Penitent models that charged), or Death Before Disgrace (destroyed Penitent models fight-on-death on a 2+).

battleFormations.name: Bringers of Flame
battleFormations.effect: Fervent Purgation: Adepta Sororitas ranged weapons gain [ASSAULT]; attacks against targets within 6" get +1 Strength.

battleFormations.name: Army of Faith
battleFormations.effect: Sacred Rites: Each Adepta Sororitas unit can perform up to two Acts of Faith per phase instead of one.

artefacts.name: Saintly Example
artefacts.effect: [ADEPTA SORORITAS model only] When the bearer is destroyed, gain an additional D3 Miracle dice.

artefacts.name: Through Suffering, Strength
artefacts.effect: [ADEPTA SORORITAS model only] +1 Attacks/Strength/Damage in melee (+2 instead if the bearer has lost any wounds).

artefacts.name: Chaplet of Sacrifice
artefacts.effect: [ADEPTA SORORITAS model only] At the end of your Command phase, re-roll one Miracle dice (up to 3 if the bearer's unit is below Starting Strength).

artefacts.name: Mantle of Ophelia
artefacts.effect: [CANONESS or PALATINE model only] Attacks allocated to the bearer have Damage changed to 1.

artefacts.name: Psalm of Righteous Judgement
artefacts.effect: [ADEPTA SORORITAS model only] When a Penitent unit destroys an enemy, discard a Miracle dice to gain one showing a 6.

artefacts.name: Verse of Holy Piety
artefacts.effect: [PENITENT model only] Once per battle, select an additional Vow of Atonement active for the bearer's unit, even if already selected this battle.

artefacts.name: Refrain of Enduring Faith
artefacts.effect: [PENITENT model only] While leading a unit, models in it gain a 5+ invulnerable save.

artefacts.name: Catechism of Divine Penitence
artefacts.effect: [CANONESS/PALATINE/MINISTORUM PRIEST model only] The bearer gains the PENITENT keyword.

artefacts.name: Righteous Rage
artefacts.effect: [ADEPTA SORORITAS model only] Discard up to 3 Miracle dice when fighting for +1 Attacks/Strength per dice discarded.

artefacts.name: Manual of Saint Griselda
artefacts.effect: [ADEPTA SORORITAS model only] At the start of your Command phase, discard up to 2 Miracle dice and gain 1 showing their combined value (max 6).

artefacts.name: Fire and Fury
artefacts.effect: [ADEPTA SORORITAS model only] While leading a unit, Torrent weapons get +1 Attacks; other ranged weapons gain [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

artefacts.name: Iron Surplice of Saint Istalela
artefacts.effect: [CANONESS or PALATINE model only] Save characteristic of 2+ and Feel No Pain 5+.

artefacts.name: Litanies of Faith
artefacts.effect: [CANONESS or PALATINE model only] At the start of your Command phase, pass a Leadership test to gain 1 Miracle dice.

artefacts.name: Blade of Saint Ellynor
artefacts.effect: [ADEPTA SORORITAS model only] +1 Strength/AP on melee weapons, gains [PRECISION]; gain 1 Miracle dice on a kill.

artefacts.name: Divine Aspect
artefacts.effect: [ADEPTA SORORITAS model only] In your Movement phase, force a nearby enemy Battle-shock test; on failure gain 1 Miracle dice.

artefacts.name: Triptych of the Macharian Crusade
artefacts.effect: [ADEPTA SORORITAS model only] Miracle-dice-substituted saving throws always succeed regardless of the dice's value.
